description: Na₄CO₄ crystallizes in the trigonal R3m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.16 Å) and two longer (2.22 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. There are three shorter (2.45 Å) and three longer (2.93 Å) Na-O bond lengths. C is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (1.37 Å) and three longer (1.45 Å) C-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom.
